items.title: Gold nudges higher with inflation risks, Fed rate path in focus
items.summary: On Friday, gold prices experienced a modest uptrend as investors weighed concerns about inflation alongside potential interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve. Spot gold saw a 0.3% increase, while US gold futures for December rose by 0.4%. St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem hinted at the necessity for further rate adjustments to combat inflation.
